市场连接已验证。: The marketplace connection has been verified.
签名包已下载；安装时仍须通过本机公钥验证。: The signed package has been downloaded. Installation still requires local public key verification.
每次投稿和更新均经过独立审核。公开目录只显示已发布版本。: Every submission and update requires independent review. The public catalog only shows published versions.
使用部署负责人提供的 HTTPS 地址；开发 HTTP 仅允许本机回环地址。: Use the HTTPS address provided by the deployment owner. Development HTTP is only allowed on loopback addresses.
市场账号独立，用户名仅用于登录；公共资料只展示公开名称。: Marketplace accounts are separate. Usernames are only used for login; public profiles only show the display name.
市场身份已刷新。: Your marketplace identity has been refreshed.
市场会话已退出。: You have signed out of the marketplace.
市场登录成功。会话仅保存在当前页面内存中。: Marketplace login succeeded. The session is only kept in this page's memory.
3 至 32 位英文字母、数字、下划线或连字符。: Use 3 to 32 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
请使用不包含个人信息的公开名称。: Use a public name that does not contain personal information.
至少 12 字节；请勿使用订阅账号密码。: At least 12 bytes. Do not reuse a subscription account password.
会话仅留在内存；退出、服务切换、会话过期或关闭页面会清除身份。: Sessions stay in memory. Signing out, switching services, session expiry or closing the page clears your identity.
当前没有可公开下载的已发布插件。: There are currently no published plugins available for public download.
所有注册用户均可投稿。修改必须使用新版本号，并重新接受独立审核。: All registered users can submit plugins. Changes require a new version number and another independent review.
包内 author 必须与当前公开展示名一致。: The package author must match your current public display name.
正在提交替代版本，原投稿保持不变。: You are submitting a replacement version. The original submission remains unchanged.
文件只在本机读取；完整隐私检查通过后才会上传。: Files are read locally and only uploaded after the full privacy check passes.
投稿已保存并进入人工审核。公开目录将在批准并发布后更新。: Your submission has been saved for manual review. The public catalog updates after approval and publication.
所有字段、描述、文件名和文件内容都会检查。发现隐私信息会阻止投稿，不会静默改写包: All fields, descriptions, file names and file contents are checked. Private information blocks submission; the package is never silently rewritten.
当前账号尚无投稿。: This account has no submissions yet.
作者不能自审。批准绑定所审阅全文的精确版本与摘要，批准后不能换包。: Authors cannot review their own submissions. Approval binds the exact version and digest of the full package reviewed; an approved package cannot be replaced.
此状态下没有投稿。: There are no submissions with this status.
当前没有待处理举报。: There are no reports awaiting action.
举报处理已记录。: The report resolution has been recorded.
签名与权限已通过本机确认，插件已安装。: The signature and permissions have been confirmed locally. The plugin has been installed.
确认安装此签名版本: Confirm installation of this signed version
公钥须从独立可信渠道核对并在本机信任；市场返回的密钥不会自动获得信任。: Verify the public key through an independently trusted channel and trust it locally. Keys returned by the marketplace are not automatically trusted.
安装后启用所选客户端；运行仍受本机隔离和权限限制。: Enable the selected clients after installation. Execution remains subject to local isolation and permission limits.
我已核对完整权限、签名指纹和所选客户端，同意安装此精确版本。: I have checked the full permissions, signing key fingerprint and selected clients, and agree to install this exact version.
确认时会重新检查公开发布内容和撤回通知；检查失败会停止安装。: Confirmation checks the public release and withdrawal notice again. Installation stops if these checks fail.
举报已保存，独立审核者将处理。: Your report has been saved for an independent reviewer.
请仅填写必要说明，不要填写个人信息或凭据。: Only include necessary details. Do not include personal information or credentials.
所审阅版本的精确摘要: Exact digest of the version under review
我已审阅此版本的完整内容和权限。: I have reviewed the full contents and permissions of this version.
精确版本和摘要已批准，等待发布。: The exact version and digest have been approved and are awaiting publication.
已要求作者使用新版本修订。: The author has been asked to submit revisions as a new version.
已批准的精确包已签名发布。: The exact approved package has been signed and published.
撤回后停止公开下载；已发布版本的签名撤回记录会保留。: Withdrawal stops public downloads. Signed withdrawal records for previously published versions are retained.
此版本已撤回，公开下载已停止。: This version has been withdrawn and public downloads have stopped.
请输入 HTTPS 市场地址；开发 HTTP 仅允许 localhost、127: Enter an HTTPS marketplace address. Development HTTP is only allowed for localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1].
请检查输入、版本号和包格式。: Check the input, version number and package format.
插件包不符合市场格式要求。: The plugin package does not meet the marketplace format requirements.
发现隐私信息或无法完整检查的内容，投稿已阻止。请在本机清理后重试。: Submission was blocked because private information or content that cannot be fully inspected was found. Clean it up locally and try again.
请重新登录独立市场账号。: Sign in to your separate marketplace account again.
市场用户名或密码不正确。: The marketplace username or password is incorrect.
当前市场身份无权执行此操作；作者不能审核自己的投稿。: This marketplace account cannot perform this action. Authors cannot review their own submissions.
此版本不可公开下载，可能尚未发布或已撤回。: This version is not available for public download. It may not be published yet or may have been withdrawn.
版本、摘要或审核状态已变化，请刷新后重新审阅。: The version, digest or review status has changed. Refresh and review it again.
操作过于频繁，请稍后重试。: Too many operations. Wait before trying again.
市场暂时无法安全完成操作，请稍后重试。: The marketplace cannot safely complete this operation right now. Try again later.
市场响应未通过安全校验，操作已停止。: The marketplace response failed security checks. The operation has stopped.
无法连接市场。请检查服务地址、网络和 HTTPS 配置。: Unable to connect to the marketplace. Check the service address, network and HTTPS configuration.
市场连接或身份已变化，请重新操作。: The marketplace connection or identity has changed. Start the operation again.
请核对完整权限、签名指纹和客户端，再明确确认。: Check the full permissions, signing key fingerprint and clients, then explicitly confirm.
此签名公钥尚未在本机独立信任，安装已阻止。请通过可信渠道核对公钥。: This signing public key is not independently trusted on this device. Installation was blocked. Verify the public key through a trusted channel.
发布者已撤回此版本，下载和安装已停止。: The publisher has withdrawn this version. Downloads and installation have stopped.
本机插件安装校验未通过，请在本地插件页检查签名信任和运行权限。: Local plugin installation checks failed. Check signing key trust and execution permissions on the local plugins page.
市场操作未完成；原始错误内容已隐藏。: The marketplace operation did not complete. The original error details have been hidden.
